Talent0_2Ability.name: World Savior
Talent0_2Ability.SpecificEffects: For each <color=#F74848>1</color> ally within <color=#F74848>3</color> adjacent tiles, DMG dealt increases by <color=#F74848>5%</color> and DMG taken reduces by <color=#F74848>5%</color>, up to <color=#F74848>20%</color>. If an enemy boss is present, pilot's combat ability increases by <color=#F74848>8%</color>.

Talent3_5Ability.name: World Savior
Talent3_5Ability.SpecificEffects:
For each <color=#F74848>1</color> ally within <color=#F74848>3</color> adjacent tiles, DMG dealt increases by <color=#F74848>5%</color> and DMG taken reduces by <color=#F74848>5%</color>, up to <color=#F74848>20%</color>. If an enemy boss is present, pilot's combat ability increases by <color=#F74848>8%</color>.
When actively attacking, own Firepower increases by <color=#F74848>2%</color> of current HP.

100001.name: Mobile Warfare 1
100001.SpecificEffects: After breaking a part, <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> can be triggered. Unable to move before the attack, and this can be effective up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

101802.name: Enlightenment
101802.SpecificEffects: When actively attacking in combat, if own HP percentage is greater or equal to the target, increases armor by <color=#F74848>80%</color>.

101803.name: Light Dragon - Shield Sheath
101803.SpecificEffects: When attacked in combat, if unable to retaliate, Shield will not suffer DMG exceeding <color=#F74848>60%</color> of its HP in a single hit.

101804.name: Good Chance! Wataru!
101804.describe: Gains <color=#F74848>2</color> AP and <buf ID=1018041>[Good Chance!]</buf>. Can continue to act with remaining movement.

101805.name: Justice Will Prevail
101805.SpecificEffects: When the number of enemies are greater than the number of allies, all allies DMG taken reduces by <color=#F74848>5%</color>. Inversely, when the number of enemies are smaller than the number of allies, all allies DMG taken increases by <color=#F74848>5%</color>.

101806.name: Light Dragon - Thunder Fist
101806.describe:
Uses an Alter-Blade to draw upon the power of Dragon God, attacking all enemies within <range type=2>3x4 square area</range> in front, dealing <color=#F74848>0.9x</color> AoE DMG, prioritizing parts with lowest HP percentage. If any part is destroyed, immediately launches the same attack <color=#F74848>1</color> more time with <color=#F74848>50%</color> reduced multiplier. Can repeat up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times. After attacking, clear terrain effect on hit tile for <color=#F74848>1</color> turn.
Can only be used with both hands intact.

101807.name: Courage
101807.SpecificEffects: Starting from <color=#F74848>2nd</color> turn, at the start of action, if AP is less than or equal to <color=#F74848>4</color>, consumes <color=#F74848>1</color> PP to recovers <color=#F74848>3</color> AP. Can gains maximum <color=#F74848>2</color> PP per attack.

101808.name: Light Dragon Ultimate - Dragon Phoenix Sword
101808.describe:
Consumes all AP to deal <color=#F74848>1.8x</color> to a target with Alter-Blade. For each <color=#F74848>1</color> AP consumed, increases this skill multiplier by <color=#F74848>0.25x</color>, up to a maximum of <color=#F74848>1.25x</color>. This skill prioritizes hitting body. DMG dealt against bosses increases by <color=#F74848>50%</color>.
This skill can only be used with an Alter-Blade and a Small Shield equipped.

100011.name: Mobile Warfare 2
100011.SpecificEffects: Upon triggering <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf>, allows movement of <color=#F74848>2</color> tiles before attacking.

100021.name: Mobile Warfare 3
100021.SpecificEffects: Destroying the target can trigger <buf ID=900005>[Re-Act]</buf>, allowing action with full movement distance.

100022.name: Power Innovation 2
100022.SpecificEffects: When breaking a part, restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

101831.name: Warrior 1
101831.SpecificEffects: When actively attacking and breaking a part, reduces <color=#F74848>1</color> PP from the target. After successful reduction, recovers <color=#F74848>1</color> AP. This effect can trigger <color=#F74848>3</color> times per turn.

100033.name: Mobile Warfare 4
100033.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> or <buf ID=900005>[Re-Act]</buf>'s effective times per turn <color=#F74848>+1</color>.

101834.name: Warrior 2
101834.SpecificEffects: When attacking non-boss enemies, Hit Rate increases by <color=#F74848>10%</color> and DMG dealt increases by <color=#F74848>15%</color>.

101835.name: Warrior 3
101835.SpecificEffects: Shield HP increases by <color=#F74848>100%</color> and Shield DMG taken reduces by <color=#F74848>10%</color>.

101836.name: Warrior 4
101836.SpecificEffects: When initiating combat, if the target is destroyed, all AP consumed by the skill are recovered, up to a maximum of <color=#F74848>3</color> AP. This effect can trigger <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

101841.name: Hero of Soukaizan 1
101841.SpecificEffects: When initiating combat with a melee weapon, if the target part HP is down to <color=#F74848>30%</color> or less, triggers a <buf ID=900001>[Flurry Strike]</buf> hitting the same part, dealing <color=#F74848>0.3x</color> DMG.

100043.name: Power Innovation 3
100043.SpecificEffects: When destroying a target, additionally restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat, effective up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

101844.name: Hero of Soukaizan 2
101844.SpecificEffects: When an enemy boss is present, AP recovery <color=#F74848>+1</color>.

101845.name: Hero of Soukaizan 3
101845.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900001>[Flurry Strike]</buf> triggered by <buf ID=1018411>[Hero of Soukaizan 1]</buf> will always be a critical hit and cannot be dodged.

101846.name: Hero of Soukaizan 4
101846.SpecificEffects: Final DMG dealt increases by <color=#F74848>10%</color>. After each <color=#F74848>1</color> ally action, gains <color=#F74848>1</color> stack of <buf ID=1018463>[Hope]</buf>, up to a maximum of <color=#F74848>3</color> stacks.
